text:
Dominique Rivera: Hey everyone  Im Dominique, joining as SRE. Day one! Quick things: laptop says "delivered" but tracking shows it at a different hub  any contacts for IT shipping? Also who do I ask about badge pickup and a small desk plant? Oh and fun fact for intros: Im learning sourdough and play cello badly.
Amit Patel: welcome Dominique! Im Amit from IT. Sorry about the routing  looks like carrier scanned to the wrong facility. Ill open a claim and request redelivery today. If its urgent we can escalate for same-day pickup at the office.
Dominique Rivera: thanks Amit. Id appreciate escalation if possible  I need to join an afternoon onboarding video and prefer company laptop.
Liza Tran: hey Dominique, Liza from People Ops. Ive scheduled your manager 1:1 at 3pm and benefits intro for next Tue 10am. Badge pickup: Facilities usually has a welcome envelope at reception under your full name. If youd like the desk plant, reply with "plant: yes" and well include a small snake plant.
Connor Shaw: hi D  congrats and welcome! For repo/VPN access ping #eng-infra and drop your public key here if you want pre-authorized. I can help if infra needs any confirmation. Preferred OS?
Dominique Rivera: MacBook please. dropping pubkey below so its easier to provision:
```
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFakeKeyExampleForThread dominique@home
```
Amit Patel: got the key, thanks. Ill attach it to your account and flag the IT ticket for expedited delivery. Ticket IT-4721.
FacilitiesBot: Dominique Rivera  welcome! Your desk is D-14 (4th floor, east pod). Reception will hold your badge in an envelope under your full name after 10:30. Plant request: queued. Reply "desk: standing" if you prefer a standing desk converter.
Dominique Rivera: desk: standing  please add converter. Also re: intro fun fact  cello + sourdough  two truths & a lie if anyone wants to guess.
Connor Shaw: my guess: cello is true, sourdough is a lie?
Liza Tran: I vote cello true, sourdough true, maybe youre lying about being "badly"  practice makes perfect :grin:
Dominique Rivera: reveal: cello true, sourdough true (starter survived!), lie = "play badly"  Im actually passable. Thanks for the warm welcome everyone. Will follow up if laptop doesnt arrive by 2pm.
OnboarderBot: Welcome Dominique Rivera. New hire packet sent. Reminders: security training due by day 5, health benefits invite sent. IT ticket IT-4721 updated: expedited redelivery requested.
